name: Tripartite Sweat Bee
desc: Tripartite Sweat Bee (Halictus tripartitus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 55 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Halictus tripartitus is a species of sweat bee in the family Halictidae. It is partially eusocial, with nests connected underground and some workers capable of reproducing.
